Black formal suit.
White shirt.
Black tie.
Realistic older gentleman appearance.

Walk around the Batcave.
Stand near the computer.
Work at the equipment station.
Speak with Bruce and Robin.
React when Batman returns.
Provide mission information.
Help with equipment.
Have idle animations.
Have natural facial expressions.

## Objective
- Fix the existing Batman game without rebuilding it, preserving current features while adding the requested story opening, Alfred presence, movement animations, and geographically distributed Riddler trophies.

## Requirements
- Preserve the original game and existing features.
- Place 25 individually accessible, collectible Riddler trophies in distinct Gotham locations; collected status must persist, and selected trophies should have nearby clues/riddles.
- Add a physical, interactive Alfred character near the Batcave workstation, with the requested appearance and supporting-character behaviors.
- Restore a playable 1982 theater opening: family seated, standing, walking through opening doors and along the sidewalk, then gunman confrontation, emotional non-graphic origin scene, fade to “26 YEARS LATER.”
- Improve walking and other movement animations across the named characters and crowds; avoid sliding and teleporting.
- Test the scenes in gameplay; do not claim unverified scenes as complete. Make reasonable assumptions and note them when finishing.
- User also requested small JPEG screenshots for checks, viewport at most 1280px wide, and reading only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- No implementation decisions or changes have been made yet.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the existing game structure and located the relevant game logic and UI.
### Active
- None; implementation has not started.
### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Implement the changes in the existing Three.js game, focusing on `game.js` and only adjusting UI/styles as needed.
2. Run the game and verify the opening sequence, Alfred interaction, walking behavior, and 25 separate persistent trophy locations in actual gameplay.
3. Save and inspect a latest small JPEG screenshot; report verified results and assumptions accurately.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Existing Three.js world, actors, collectibles, story dialogue, controls, interaction, and animation loop.
- `index.html`: Game HUD and overlay markup, including current start screen, dialogue, and objective UI.
- `style.css`: Existing HUD and responsive game presentation.
- `README.md`: Project readme.

## Important Context
- `game.js` currently generates 25 trophies among 40 evidence items at random positions and does not persist collected status.
- Alfred currently exists as a dressed NPC at `(2, 0, 5)`; no physical Batcave layout or full Alfred behaviors were found.
- The start button currently plays a sequence of dialogue cards (`intro`) describing the origin rather than a playable theater cutscene.
- Player and companion have simple limb rotation during movement; broader character animation and pathing are not established.
- No files have been modified; repository changes remain uncommitted.
